es.title: Big Tech Is Now Borrowing to Build: The Bond Bill Hiding Behind the AI Boom

segments.src: For most of the past two decades, the defining financial fact about America's largest technology companies was how much money they had lying around.
segments.tr: Durante la mayor parte de las últimas dos décadas, el hecho financiero determinante sobre las mayores empresas tecnológicas de EE. UU. era la enorme cantidad de dinero en efectivo que tenían disponible.

segments.src: Cash piles measured in the hundreds of billions became a running joke on earnings calls and a genuine policy question in Washington.
segments.tr: Las reservas de efectivo valoradas en cientos de miles de millones se convirtieron en un chiste recurrente en las llamadas de resultados y en una verdadera cuestión de política pública en Washington.

segments.src: The companies were so liquid that the main debate was what to do with the surplus: buy back stock, pay dividends, or park it offshore.
segments.tr: Las empresas eran tan líquidas que el debate principal era qué hacer con el superávit: recomprar acciones, pagar dividendos o mantenerlo en el extranjero.

segments.src: That framing is quietly going out of date.
segments.tr: Ese enfoque está quedando obsoleto silenciosamente.

segments.src: The build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure has turned the most cash-generative businesses in the world into some of the largest borrowers in the corporate bond market — not because they are short of money, but because even their extraordinary cash flow no longer covers the bill.
segments.tr: El despliegue de la infraestructura de inteligencia artificial ha convertido a las empresas que más efectivo generan en el mundo en algunos de los mayores prestatarios del mercado de bonos corporativos, no porque les falte dinero, sino porque incluso su extraordinario flujo de caja ya no alcanza para cubrir la cuenta.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spend
segments.tr: ## La escala del gasto

segments.src: Estimates compiled from company guidance and analyst models put combined 2026 capital expenditure across the major hyperscalers at upward of **$750 billion**.
segments.tr: Las estimaciones elaboradas a partir de las previsiones de las empresas y los modelos de los analistas sitúan el gasto de capital combinado para 2026 en los principales hyperscalers por encima de los **$750 billion**.

segments.src: To put that in perspective, it is a figure that would have described the entire capital spending of the S&P 500's industrial sector not long ago.
segments.tr: Para ponerlo en perspectiva, es una cifra que no hace mucho habría descrito todo el gasto de capital del sector industrial del S&P 500.

segments.src: The more revealing number is the ratio.
segments.tr: El número más revelador es la proporción.

segments.src: That spending represents roughly **94% of the group's operating cash flow** — meaning almost every dollar these companies generate from running their existing businesses is being committed to building the next one.
segments.tr: Ese gasto representa aproximadamente el **94% del flujo de caja operativo del grupo**, lo que significa que casi cada dólar que estas empresas generan con la gestión de sus negocios actuales se está comprometiendo para construir el siguiente.

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: Históricamente, las grandes tecnológicas convertían el flujo de caja operativo en flujo de caja libre a un ritmo cómodo, dejando amplio margen para recompras de acciones y dividendos.

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: Ese colchón se ha reducido drásticamente.

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: Y dado que los programas de retorno al accionista no se han recortado proporcionalmente, la brecha debe cubrirse en alguna parte.

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: Se está cubriendo con deuda.

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## 194 mil millones de dólares en seis meses

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: Los recuentos de mercado sobre emisiones con grado de inversión sugieren que los emisores de tecnología y comunicaciones vendieron alrededor de **$194 billion de bonos con grado de inversión solo en la primera mitad de 2026**, un ritmo que habría sido impensable para este sector hace cinco años, cuando varias de estas firmas mantenían posiciones netas de efectivo y emitían deuda principalmente por razones de oportunidad o fiscales.

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente **un tercio del programa de capex se está financiando con dinero prestado**.

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: Esto es un cambio estructural, no una anomalía de un solo trimestre.

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: Cambia lo que son estas empresas desde el punto de vista financiero: de ser empresas de crecimiento autofinanciadas a constructores de gran intensidad de capital con un calendario de vencimientos que gestionar.

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## ¿Por qué endeudarse cuando se tiene el efectivo?

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: Existen varias razones defendibles y vale la pena separarlas de la interpretación alarmista.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **Coincidencia de activos y pasivos.** Los centros de datos, las subestaciones y los terrenos son activos de larga duración.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: Financiar un activo a 20 años con deuda a 10 o 30 años es finanzas corporativas de manual, no una imprudencia.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: Los chips son una historia diferente: su vida útil es discutida, y ahí es donde el argumento se vuelve interesante.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **Preservar la flexibilidad.** El efectivo en el balance representa opcionalidad: para adquisiciones, para recompras durante una caída del mercado o para capear un mal año.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: Agotarlo a cero para financiar la construcción dejaría a estas empresas más frágiles, no menos.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **Las matemáticas siguen funcionando, por ahora.** Los prestatarios con grado de inversión y sólidas calificaciones pueden captar dinero a largo plazo a tasas que se mantienen por debajo de su rendimiento esperado sobre el capital invertido, al menos según las proyecciones que sustentan estos programas.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: Si las proyecciones se mantienen, el apalancamiento genera valor.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **Mecánica fiscal y jurisdiccional.** Los intereses son deducibles; repatriar y desplegar efectivo no siempre está libre de fricciones.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: La optimización aquí es ordinaria y legítima.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: El resumen honesto es que endeudarse para construir es algo normal en una industria con uso intensivo de capital.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: Lo nuevo es que *esta* industria se ha vuelto de uso intensivo de capital.

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## Lo que los inversores en bonos han comenzado a descontar

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: Los mercados de crédito han absorbido la oferta, pero no de forma gratuita.

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr: Se observan algunas dinámicas en cómo cotiza la deuda y cómo se está estructurando:

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr: - **Riesgo de concentración en el índice.** A medida que crece la emisión tecnológica, los fondos pasivos con grado de inversión asumen de forma mecánica más exposición a una única temática altamente correlacionada. Un inversor que compró un fondo amplio de bonos IG para diversificar puede tener ahora una apuesta significativa en la economía de la infraestructura de IA.

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr: - **Diferenciación modesta en los spreads.** No todo el papel de los hyperscalers cotiza por igual. Los inversores diferencian cada vez más entre emisores en función de la visibilidad de los ingresos que se supone que respaldarán la deuda, y de qué parte del capex está comprometida frente a la discrecional.

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr: - **Preferencia en la curva.** La demanda ha sido notablemente más firme en los vencimientos cortos e intermedios que en el tramo muy largo, donde se pide a los inversores que garanticen la durabilidad de la demanda de IA a dos y tres décadas vista.

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Estructuras más allá de los bonos ordinarios.** Una parte creciente de la construcción se está financiando a través de joint ventures, vehículos de propósito especial (SPV), crédito privado y arrendamientos a largo plazo. No son necesariamente problemáticos, pero hacen que el apalancamiento del balance principal sea una imagen incompleta de las obligaciones totales.

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: Ese último punto es el que más importa a cualquiera que intente calibrar el riesgo.

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: La cifra del mercado de bonos es la parte visible.

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: La huella de financiación completa, incluidas las estructuras fuera de balance y financiadas por socios, es mayor y más difícil de medir desde el exterior.

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## Los argumentos para la preocupación

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: Tres cosas tendrían que cumplirse para que esto termine mal, y ninguna de ellas es descabellada.

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **Las hipótesis de depreciación resultan ser optimistas.** Varias firmas extendieron la vida útil asumida del equipo de servidores en años recientes, lo que reduce la depreciación reportada y favorece los beneficios.

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: Si los aceleradores de IA quedan funcionalmente obsoletos más rápido de lo que asumen los calendarios, los beneficios reportados habrán estado tomando prestado del futuro, y la deuda emitida contra esos beneficios no se ajusta.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **Los ingresos se integran más lentamente de lo que se añade la capacidad.** La capacidad se está construyendo por delante de la demanda de forma deliberada; así es como se ve una carrera de infraestructura.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: Pero la brecha entre el gasto y la monetización se está financiando actualmente.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: Una brecha prolongada convierte una historia de crecimiento en un problema de refinanciación.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **Las tasas o los spreads se mueven en su contra en el momento equivocado.** Se trata de créditos sólidos con flujo de caja real.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: Pero el muro de vencimientos que se está creando ahora se refinanciará en condiciones que nadie puede prever, y la suposición de que la tecnología IG siempre encontrará demanda no se ha probado a este volumen.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## Los argumentos para la calma

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: El contraargumento no es débil.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: Los ratios de apalancamiento en la mayoría de estos emisores siguen siendo bajos según cualquier estándar corporativo histórico: cifras de deuda neta sobre EBITDA que una empresa de servicios públicos o un operador de telecomunicaciones considerarían envidiables.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: La cobertura de intereses es extraordinaria.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: Los negocios que financian los pagos de intereses (nube, publicidad, software empresarial) se encuentran entre los motores de efectivo más duraderos jamás construidos, y siguen creciendo.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: También hay un activo real al final de esto.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: A diferencia del despliegue de fibra de finales de los noventa, que produjo una capacidad que permaneció inactiva durante años, gran parte del cómputo actual se consume a medida que se entrega.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: La utilización, donde las empresas la desglosan, ha sido generalmente alta.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: La postura razonable no es "esto es una burbuja financiada con deuda" ni "estas empresas pueden permitírselo todo".

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: Es que el perfil de riesgo de todo un sector ha cambiado, y el mercado está en pleno proceso de revaluarlo en tiempo real.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## En qué fijarse realmente

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr: Para los lectores que siguen esto más como observadores que como operadores, un puñado de indicadores aporta más señal que las cifras de capex titulares:

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr: - **Flujo de caja libre, no flujo de caja operativo.** El flujo de caja operativo le dice si el negocio es saludable. El flujo de caja libre le dice qué queda tras la construcción.

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr: - **Cambios en los calendarios de depreciación** divulgados en los informes: una extensión de la vida útil es un ajuste silencioso de los beneficios.

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr: - **La proporción de capex comprometido frente a discrecional.** El gasto discrecional se puede recortar en una desaceleración; los compromisos contractuales no.

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr: - **Comportamiento del spread en las emisiones.** Si las nuevas emisiones fijan precio con una concesión respecto al papel existente es el veredicto en directo del mercado.

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr: - **Divulgación de obligaciones de JV, SPV y arrendamientos**, que se sitúan cada vez más fuera de la cifra principal de deuda.

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **Cualquier señal de que los programas de retorno al accionista se están recortando**: eso sería una señal de la dirección de que el cálculo del efectivo se ha vuelto más ajustado de lo que sugieren las previsiones.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: El despliegue de la IA se está financiando de la misma manera que siempre se ha financiado la gran infraestructura: con dinero de otras personas, a plazos largos y frente a la demanda proyectada.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: Eso no es escandaloso.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: Es simplemente un modelo de negocio diferente al que los inversores se acostumbraron, con un conjunto diferente de modos de fallo.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: Las empresas que eran famosas por no tener deuda ahora tienen un calendario de vencimientos.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: Si eso resulta ser una asignación prudente de capital o una lección costosa depende de una pregunta que nadie puede responder todavía: si los ingresos llegarán en el mismo plazo que los pagos de intereses.

segments.tr: ## لماذا الاقتراض بينما تملك النقد؟

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: هناك عدة أسباب قابلة للدفاع عنها، وتستحق الفصل عن التفسير المثير للقلق.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **مطابقة الأصول بالالتزامات.** مراكز البيانات، والمحطات الفرعية، والأراضي هي أصول طويلة الأجل.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: تمويل أصل مدته 20 عاماً بديون لمدة 10 أو 30 عاماً هو أمر نموذجي في مالية الشركات، وليس تهوراً.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: الرقائق قصة مختلفة — فالعمر النافع لها محل خلاف، وهنا يصبح النقاش مثيراً للاهتمام.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **الحفاظ على المرونة.** النقد في الميزانية العمومية هو اختيارية: للاستحواذات، ولإعادة الشراء أثناء الهبوط، ولتجاوز سنة سيئة.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: واستنفاده إلى الصفر لتمويل البناء سيجعل هذه الشركات أكثر هشاشة، وليس أقل.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **الحسابات لا تزال تعمل — في الوقت الحالي.** يمكن للمقترضين من ذوي الدرجة الاستثمارية والتصنيفات القوية جمع أموال طويلة الأجل بمعدلات تظل أقل من عائدهم المتوقع على رأس المال المستثمر، على الأقل وفقاً للتوقعات التي تستند إليها هذه البرامج.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: إذا استمرت التوقعات، فإن الرافعة المالية تكون معززة للقيم.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **آليات الضرائب والاختصاص القضائي.** الفوائد قابلة للخصم؛ وإعادة الأموال ونشر النقد ليس خالية من العوائق دائماً.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: التحسين هنا عادياً ومشروعاً.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: الملخص الصريح هو أن الاقتراض للبناء أمر طبيعي لقطاع كثيف رأس المال.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: الجديد هو أن *هذا* القطاع أصبح الآن كثيف رأس المال.

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## ما بدأ مستثمرو السندات في تسعيره

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: استوعبت أسواق الائتمان المعروض، ولكن ليس مجاناً.

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr: تظهر بعض الديناميكيات في كيفية تداول الديون وكيفية هيكلتها:

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr: - **مخاطر التركيز في المؤشر.** مع نمو إصدارات التكنولوجيا، تتأثر صناديق الدرجة الاستثمارية السلبية ميكانيكياً بتعرض أكبر لطابع واحد عالي الترابط. المستثمر الذي اشترى صندوق سندات IG واسع النطاق للتنويع قد يحمل الآن رهاناً كبيراً على اقتصاديات البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي.

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr: - **تمايز متواضع في الفوارق.** لا تتداول جميع أوراق hyperscaler بالتساوي. يفرق المستثمرون بشكل متزايد بين الميزات بناءً على وضوح الإيرادات التي من المفترض أن تخدم الدين، وعلى مقدار الإنفاق الرأسمالي الملتزم به مقابل الاختياري.

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr: - **تفضيل المنحنى.** كان الطلب أقوى بشكل ملحوظ عند الاستحقاقات القصيرة والمتوسطة مقارنة بالنهاية الطويلة جداً، حيث يُطلب من المستثمرين التغطية لاستدامة طلب الذكاء الاصطناعي لعقدين وثلاثة عقود قادمة.

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **هياكل تتجاوز السندات العادية.** يتم تمويل حصة متزايدة من البناء من خلال المشاريع المشتركة، والشركات ذات الغرض الخاص (SPV)، والائتمان الخاص، وعقود الإيجار طويلة الأجل. هذه ليست إشكالية بالضرورة، لكنها تجعل الرافعة المالية المعلنة في الميزانية العمومية صورة غير مكتملة لإجمالي الالتزامات.

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: هذه النقطة الأخيرة هي الأكثر أهمية لأي شخص يحاول قياس حجم المخاطر.

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: رقم سوق السندات هو الجزء الظاهر.

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: إن الأثر التمويلي الكامل — بما في ذلك الهياكل خارج الميزانية العمومية والممولة من الشركاء — أكبر وأصعب في القياس من الخارج.

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## مبررات القلق

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: ثلاثة أشياء يجب أن تكون صحيحة لكي ينتهي هذا بشكل سيئ، ولا أحد منها بعيد الاحتمال.

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **اثبات افتراضات الاستهلاك أنها متفائلة.** قامت عدة شركات بتمديد العمر النافع المفترض لمعدات الخوادم في السنوات الأخيرة، مما يقلل من الاستهلاك المسجل ويجمل الأرباح.

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: إذا أصبحت تسريعات الذكاء الاصطناعي غير صالحة للاستخدام وظيفياً بأسرع مما تفترضه الجداول، فإن الأرباح المعلنة كانت تقترض من المستقبل — والدين المرفوع مقابل تلك الأرباح لا يتعدل.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **ارتباط الإيرادات بشكل أبطأ من إضافة الطاقة الاستيعابية.** يتم بناء الطاقة الاستيعابية سباقة للطلب تصميماً؛ هذا ما يبدو عليه سباق البنية التحتية.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: لكن الفجوة بين الإنفاق وتحقيق الدخل يتم تمويلها حالياً.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: الفجوة المطولة تحول قصة النمو إلى مشكلة إعادة تمويل.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **تحرك المعدات أو الفوارق ضدها في اللحظة الخاطئة.** هذه ائتمانات قوية مع تدفق نقدي حقيقي.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: لكن جدران الاستحقاق التي تـُنشأ الآن سيتم إعادة تمويلها تحت ظروف لا يمكن لأحد التنبؤ بها، والافتراض بأن تكنولوجيا IG ستجد دائماً عرضاً لم يُختبر عند هذا الحجم.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## مبررات الهدوء

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: الحجة المضادة ليست ضعيفة.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: تظل نسب الرافعة المالية لدى معظم هؤلاء المصدقين منخفضة بأي المعايير التاريخية للشركات — أرقام صافي الدين إلى EBITDA التي قد تعتبرها شركة مرافق أو مشغل اتصالات موضع حسد.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: تغطية الفوائد استثنائية.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: الأعمال التي تمول مدفوعات الفائدة — السحابة، الإعلانات، برمجيات المؤسسات — هي من بين أكثر المحركات النقدية استدامة على الإطلاق، ولا تزال تنمو.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: وهناك أيضاً أصل حقيقي في نهاية هذا.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: على عكس بناء الألياف الضوئية في أواخر التسعينيات، والذي أنتج طاقة استيعابية ظلت معطلة لسنوات، فإن الكثير من الحوسبة اليوم يتم استهلاكها بمجرد التسليم.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: الاستخدام، حيث تفصح عنه الشركات، كان عالياً بشكل عام.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: الموقف المعقول ليس "هذه فقاعة ممولة بالديون" ولا "هذه الشركات تستطيع تحمل كل شيء".

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: بل هو أن ملف المخاطر لقطاع بأكمله قد تغير، والسوق في منتصف إعادة تسعيره في الوقت الفعلي.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته فعلياً

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr: للقراء الذين يتابعون هذا بدلاً من التداول فيه، توفر حفنة من المؤشرات إشارات أكثر من أرقام الإنفاق الرأسمالي الرئيسية:

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr: - **التدفق النقدي الحر، وليس التدفق النقدي التشغيلي.** يخبرك التدفق النقدي التشغيلي أن العمل صحي. ويخبرك التدفق النقدي الحر بما يتبقى بعد البناء.

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr: - **التغييرات في جداول الاستهلاك** المفصح عنها في الإيداعات — تمديد العمر النافع هو تعديل هادئ للأرباح.

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr: - **نسبة الإنفاق الرأسمالي الملتزم به إلى الاختياري.** يمكن قطع الإنفاق الاختياري في فترة التراجع؛ ولا يمكن قطع الالتزامات التعاقدية.

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr: - **سلوك الفارق عند الإصدار.** ما إذا كانت الصفقات الجديدة تُسعَّر بخصم بالنسبة للأوراق الحالية هو الحكم المباشر للسوق.

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr: - **الإفصاح عن التزامات المشاريع المشتركة (JV)، والشركات ذات الغرض الخاص (SPV)، وعقود الإيجار**، والتي تقع بشكل متزايد خارج رقم الدين الرئيسي.

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **أي علامة على أن برامج عوائد المساهمين يتم تقليصها** — سيكون ذلك إشارة من الإدارة بأن حسابات النقد أصبحت أكثر ضيقاً مما تلمح إليه الإرشادات.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: يتم تمويل التوسع في الذكاء الاصطناعي بالطريقة التي طالما تم بها تمويل البنية التحتية الكبيرة: بأموال أشخاص آخرين، وعلى أطر زمنية طويلة، مقابل الطلب المتوقع.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: هذا ليس فضيحة.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: إنه مجرد نموذج أعمال مختلف عن ذلك الذي اعتاد عليه المستثمرون، مع مجموعة مختلفة من أنماط الفشل.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: الشركات التي كانت مشهورة بعدم وجود ديون لديها الآن جدول زمني للاستحقاقات.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: ما إذا كان ذلك سيتبين أنه تخصيص حكيم لرأس المال أم درس مكلف يعتمد على سؤال لا يمكن لأحد الإجابة عليه بعد — ما إذا كانت الإيرادات ستصل في نفس الجدول الزمني لمدفوعات الفائدة.

segments.src: *This article is general information and commentary on publicly reported market data.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة هي معلومات عامة وتعليق على بيانات السوق المعلنة بشكل عام.

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates drawn from company disclosures and market tallies and may be revised.
segments.tr: الأرقام المذكورة هي تقديرات مستمدة من إفصاحات الشركات وإحصاءات السوق وقد يتم تعديلها.

segments.src: It is not investment advice, and it is not a recommendation to buy or sell any security.
segments.tr: إنها ليست نصيحة استثمارية، وليست توصية بشراء أو بيع أي أوراق مالية.

segments.src: Consult a qualified financial professional before making investment decisions.*
segments.tr: استشر ماليًا محترفًا مؤهلاً قبل اتخاذ قرارات استثمارية.*

fr.title: Big Tech Is Now Borrowing to Build: The Bond Bill Hiding Behind the AI Boom

segments.src: For most of the past two decades, the defining financial fact about America's largest technology companies was how much money they had lying around.
segments.tr: Pendant la majeure partie des deux dernières décennies, le fait financier marquant concernant les plus grandes entreprises technologiques américaines était la quantité d'argent liquide dont elles disposaient.

segments.src: Cash piles measured in the hundreds of billions became a running joke on earnings calls and a genuine policy question in Washington.
segments.tr: Des réserves de trésorerie se comptant en centaines de milliards sont devenues une plaisanterie récurrente lors des appels de résultats et une véritable question politique à Washington.

segments.src: The companies were so liquid that the main debate was what to do with the surplus: buy back stock, pay dividends, or park it offshore.
segments.tr: Les entreprises étaient si liquides que le débat principal portait sur la manière d'utiliser cet excédent : racheter des actions, verser des dividendes ou le placer à l'étranger.

segments.src: That framing is quietly going out of date.
segments.tr: Ce cadre est doucement en train de devenir obsolète.

segments.src: The build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure has turned the most cash-generative businesses in the world into some of the largest borrowers in the corporate bond market — not because they are short of money, but because even their extraordinary cash flow no longer covers the bill.
segments.tr: Le déploiement de l'infrastructure d'intelligence artificielle a transformé les entreprises les plus génératrices de trésorerie au monde en certains des plus grands emprunteurs du marché des obligations d'entreprises — non pas parce qu'elles manquent d'argent, mais parce que même leur flux de trésorerie extraordinaire ne suffit plus à régler la facture.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spend
segments.tr: ## L'ampleur des dépenses

segments.src: Estimates compiled from company guidance and analyst models put combined 2026 capital expenditure across the major hyperscalers at upward of **$750 billion**.
segments.tr: Les estimations compilées à partir des prévisions des entreprises et des modèles d'analystes situent les dépenses de capital combinées pour 2026 de l'ensemble des grands hyperscalers à plus de **$750 billion**.

segments.src: To put that in perspective, it is a figure that would have described the entire capital spending of the S&P 500's industrial sector not long ago.
segments.tr: Pour mettre cela en perspective, c'est un chiffre qui aurait décrit l'ensemble des dépenses d'investissement du secteur industriel du S&P 500 il n'y a pas si longtemps.

segments.src: The more revealing number is the ratio.
segments.tr: Le chiffre le plus révélateur est le ratio.

segments.src: That spending represents roughly **94% of the group's operating cash flow** — meaning almost every dollar these companies generate from running their existing businesses is being committed to building the next one.
segments.tr: Ces dépenses représentent environ **94% du flux de trésorerie d'exploitation du groupe**, ce qui signifie que presque chaque dollar généré par ces entreprises grâce à l'exploitation de leurs activités existantes est engagé dans la construction de la suivante.

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: Historiquement, les géants de la tech convertissaient le flux de trésorerie d'exploitation en flux de trésorerie disponible à un rythme confortable, laissant une marge ample pour les rachats d'actions et les dividendes.

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: Coussin qui s'est considérablement réduit.

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: Et comme les programmes de retour aux actionnaires n'ont pas été réduits de manière proportionnelle, l'écart doit être comblé quelque part.

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: Il est comblé par de la dette.

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## 194 milliards de dollars en six mois

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: Les décomptes de marché sur les émissions de qualité d'investissement suggèrent que les émetteurs des secteurs de la technologie et des communications ont vendu de l'ordre de **$194 billion d'obligations de qualité d'investissement uniquement au premier semestre 2026** — un rythme qui aurait été impensable pour ce secteur il y a cinq ans, lorsque plusieurs de ces sociétés affichaient des positions de trésorerie nette et n'émettaient de la dette principalement que pour des raisons d'opportunité ou fiscales.

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: Environ **un tiers du programme de capex est financé par de l'argent emprunté**.

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: C'est un changement structurel, pas une anomalie d'un seul trimestre.

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: Cela modifie la nature même de ces entreprises, sur le plan financier : de sociétés à fort effet de capitalisation autofinancées, elles deviennent des bâtisseurs à forte intensité de capital avec un calendrier d'échéances à gérer.

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi emprunter quand on a du cash ?

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: Il existe plusieurs raisons défendables, et il convient de les séparer d'une interprétation alarmiste.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **Adossement actif-passif.** Les centres de données, les sous-stations et les terrains sont des actifs à longue durée de vie.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: Financer un actif sur 20 ans avec une dette à 10 ou 30 ans relève de la finance d'entreprise classique, pas de l'imprudence.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: Les puces sont une autre histoire — leur durée de vie utile est contestée, et c'est là que l'argument devient intéressant.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **PRÉSERVER LA FLEXIBILITÉ.** Le cash au bilan offre de la flexibilité : pour des acquisitions, pour des rachats d'actions pendant une baisse, pour traverser une mauvaise année.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: L'épuiser jusqu'à zéro pour financer la construction rendrait ces entreprises plus fragiles, et non moins.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **L'équation fonctionne toujours — pour l'instant.** Les emprunteurs de qualité d'investissement bénéficiant de solides notations peuvent lever des fonds à long terme à des taux qui restent inférieurs à leur rendement attendu sur le capital investi, du moins selon les projections qui sous-tendent ces programmes.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: Si les projections se maintiennent, le levier est créateur de valeur.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **Mécanismes fiscaux et juridictionnels.** Les intérêts sont déductibles ; rapatrier et déployer de la trésorerie ne se fait pas toujours sans friction.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: L'optimisation ici est banale et légitime.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: Le résumé honnête est que s'endetter pour construire est une chose normale pour une industrie à forte intensité de capital.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: Ce qui est nouveau, c'est que *cette* industrie est désormais à forte intensité de capital.

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## Ce que les investisseurs obligataires ont commencé à intégrer dans les prix

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: Les marchés du crédit ont absorbé l'offre, mais pas gratuitement.

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr: Quelques dynamiques sont visibles dans la manière dont la dette s'échange et dont elle est structurée :

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr: - **Risque de concentration dans l'indice.** À mesure que les émissions technologiques augmentent, les fonds passifs de qualité d'investissement prennent mécaniquement une exposition plus forte à une thématique unique et très corrélée. Un investisseur ayant acheté un fonds obligataire IG large pour se diversifier peut désormais détenir un pari significatif sur l'économie de l'infrastructure de l'IA.

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr: - **Modeste différenciation des spreads.** Tous les titres des hyperscalers ne s'échangent pas de la même manière. Les investisseurs font de plus en plus la distinction entre les émetteurs en fonction de la visibilité des revenus censés assurer le service de la dette, et selon la part du capex qui est engagée par rapport à celle qui est discrétionnaire.

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr: - **Préférence de courbe.** La demande a été nettement plus ferme sur les échéances courtes et intermédiaires que sur le très long terme, où l'on demande aux investisseurs de garantir la durabilité de la demande d'IA à deux ou trois décennies.

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Structures au-delà des obligations classiques.** Une part croissante des constructions est financée par des coentreprises (JV), des véhicules à fin spéciale (SPV), du crédit privé et des baux à long terme. Ces structures ne sont pas nécessairement problématiques, mais elles font du levier apparent du bilan une image incomplète des obligations totales.

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: Ce dernier point est le plus important pour quiconque tente d'évaluer le risque.

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: Le chiffre du marché obligataire est la partie visible.

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: L'empreinte financière globale — y compris les structures hors bilan et financées par des partenaires — est plus vaste et plus difficile à mesurer de l'extérieur.

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## Les raisons de s'inquiéter

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: Trois conditions devraient être réunies pour que cela se termine mal, et aucune d'entre elles n'est irréaliste.

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **Les hypothèses d'amortissement s'avèrent optimistes.** Plusieurs entreprises ont allongé la durée de vie utile supposée des équipements serveurs ces dernières années, ce qui réduit l'amortissement comptabilisé et embellit les résultats.

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: Si les accélérateurs d'IA deviennent fonctionnellement obsolètes plus rapidement que ne le prévoient les calendriers, les bénéfices déclarés auront emprunté au futur — et la dette levée sur la base de ces bénéfices ne s'ajuste pas.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **Les revenus se concrétisent plus lentement que la capacité n'est ajoutée.** La capacité est construite en avance sur la demande par conception ; c'est à cela que ressemble una course aux infrastructures.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: Mais l'écart entre les dépenses et la monétisation est actuellement financé.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: Un écart prolongé transforme une histoire de croissance en un problème de refinancement.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **Les taux ou les spreads évoluent en leur défaveur au mauvais moment.** Ce sont de solides signatures disposant d'un flux de trésorerie réel.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: Mais le mur d'échéances en cours de création devra être refinancé dans des conditions que personne ne peut prévoir, et l'hypothèse selon laquelle la tech IG trouvera toujours acheteur n'a pas été testée à ce volume.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## Les raisons de garder son calme

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: Le contre-argument n'est pas faible.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: Les ratios de levier chez la plupart de ces émetteurs restent faibles par rapport à toutes les normes historiques d'entreprise — des chiffres de dette nette sur EBITDA qu'un opérateur de services publics ou de télécoms jugerait enviables.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: La couverture des intérêts est extraordinaire.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: Les activités qui financent le paiement des intérêts — cloud, publicité, logiciels d'entreprise — figurent parmi les moteurs de trésorerie les plus durables jamais créés, et elles continuent de croître.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: Il y a également un actif réel au bout du compte.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: Contrairement à la construction du réseau en fibre à la fin des années 1990, qui a produit une capacité restée inutilisée pendant des années, une grande partie de la puissance de calcul d'aujourd'hui est consommée dès sa livraison.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: Le taux d'utilisation, là où les entreprises le divulguent, a généralement été élevé.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: La position raisonnable n'est ni « c'est une bulle financée par de la dette » ni « ces entreprises peuvent tout se permettre ».

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: Elle consiste à reconnaître que le profil de risque de tout un secteur a changé, et que le marché est en train de le réévaluer en temps réel.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut réellement surveiller

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs qui suivent cela de près plutôt que d'effectuer des transactions, une poignée d'indicateurs apporte plus de signal que les chiffres bruts de capex :

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr: - **Le flux de trésorerie disponible, pas le flux de trésorerie d'exploitation.** Le flux de trésorerie d'exploitation vous indique que l'entreprise est saine. Le flux de trésorerie disponible vous indique ce qu'il reste après les investissements.

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr: - **Les modifications des calendriers d'amortissement** divulguées dans les documents financiers — un allongement de la durée de vie utile est un ajustement discret des résultats.

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr: - **Le ratio du capex engagé par rapport au capex discrétionnaire.** Les dépenses discrétionnaires peuvent être réduites en cas de ralentissement ; les engagements contractuels ne le peuvent pas.

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr: - **Le comportement des spreads lors de l'émission.** La question de savoir si les nouvelles opérations sont émises avec une prime par rapport aux titres existants constitue le verdict en direct du marché.

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr: - **La divulgation des obligations liées aux JV, SPV et baux**, qui se situent de plus en plus en dehors du chiffre principal de la dette.

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **Tout signe indiquant que les programmes de retour aux actionnaires sont réduits** — ce serait le signal donné par la direction que l'équation de trésorerie est devenue plus tendue que ne le suggèrent les prévisions.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: Le déploiement de l'IA est financé comme les grandes infrastructures l'ont toujours été : avec l'argent des autres, sur de longs horizons temporels, en fonction d'une demande projetée.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas scandaleux.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: C'est simplement un modèle d'affaires différent de celui auquel les investisseurs s'étaient habitués, avec un ensemble différent de modes de défaillance.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: Les entreprises qui étaient célèbres pour n'avoir aucune dette ont désormais un calendrier d'échéances.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: Que cela s'avère être une allocation prudente du capital ou une leçon coûteuse dépend d'une question à laquelle personne ne peut encore répondre — celle de savoir si les revenus arriveront dans les mêmes délais que le paiement des intérêts.

pt.title: Big Tech Agora Está Pegando Empréstimos para Construir: A Conta de Títulos por Trás do Boom de IA

segments.src: For most of the past two decades, the defining financial fact about America's largest technology companies was how much money they had lying around.
segments.tr: Na maior parte das últimas duas décadas, o fato financeiro definidor sobre as maiores empresas de tecnologia da América era a quantidade de dinheiro que elas tinham disponível.

segments.src: Cash piles measured in the hundreds of billions became a running joke on earnings calls and a genuine policy question in Washington.
segments.tr: Pilhas de caixa medidas em centenas de bilhões tornaram-se uma piada recorrente nas chamadas de resultados e uma verdadeira questão de política em Washington.

segments.src: The companies were so liquid that the main debate was what to do with the surplus: buy back stock, pay dividends, or park it offshore.
segments.tr: As empresas eram tão líquidas que o principal debate era o que fazer com o excedente: recomprar ações, pagar dividendos ou mantê-lo no exterior.

segments.src: That framing is quietly going out of date.
segments.tr: Essa abordagem está discretamente ficando ultrapassada.

segments.src: The build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure has turned the most cash-generative businesses in the world into some of the largest borrowers in the corporate bond market — not because they are short of money, but because even their extraordinary cash flow no longer covers the bill.
segments.tr: A expansão da infraestrutura de inteligência artificial transformou os negócios mais geradores de caixa do mundo em alguns dos maiores tomadores de empréstimo no mercado de títulos corporativos — não porque estejam sem dinheiro, mas porque mesmo seu fluxo de caixa extraordinário não cobre mais a conta.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spend
segments.tr: ## A escala dos gastos

segments.src: Estimates compiled from company guidance and analyst models put combined 2026 capital expenditure across the major hyperscalers at upward of **$750 billion**.
segments.tr: Estimativas compiladas a partir de orientações das empresas e modelos de analistas apontam que as despesas de capital combinadas para 2026 entre os principais hyperscalers ultrapassarão **$750 bilhões**.

segments.src: To put that in perspective, it is a figure that would have described the entire capital spending of the S&P 500's industrial sector not long ago.
segments.tr: Para colocar isso em perspectiva, é um valor que descreveria todo o gasto de capital do setor industrial do S&P 500 há não muito tempo.

segments.src: The more revealing number is the ratio.
segments.tr: O número mais revelador é a proporção.

segments.src: That spending represents roughly **94% of the group's operating cash flow** — meaning almost every dollar these companies generate from running their existing businesses is being committed to building the next one.
segments.tr: Esse gasto representa aproximadamente **94% do fluxo de caixa operacional do grupo** — o que significa que quase cada dólar que essas empresas geram na operação de seus negócios existentes está sendo comprometido para construir o próximo.

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: Historicamente, a big tech convertia fluxo de caixa operacional em fluxo de caixa livre a um ritmo confortável, deixando amplo espaço para recompras e dividendos.

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: Essa folga diminuiu drasticamente.

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: E como os programas de retorno aos acionistas não foram cortados proporcionalmente, a lacuna precisa ser preenchida de alguma forma.

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: Ela está sendo preenchida com dívida.

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## $194 bilhões em seis meses

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: Contagens de mercado sobre emissões de grau de investimento sugerem que emissores de tecnologia e comunicações venderam cerca de **$194 bilhões em títulos de grau de investimento apenas no primeiro semestre de 2026** — um ritmo que seria impensável para este setor há cinco anos, quando várias dessas empresas mantinham posições líquidas de caixa e emitiam dívidas principalmente por razões oportunistas ou fiscais.

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente **um terço do programa de capex está sendo financiado com dinheiro emprestado**.

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: Isso é uma mudança estrutural, não uma anomalia de um único trimestre.

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: Isso altera o que essas empresas são, financeiramente falando: de geradoras autofinanciáveis para construtoras intensivas em capital com um cronograma de vencimentos para gerenciar.

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## Por que tomar emprestado quando se tem caixa?

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: Existem várias razões defensáveis, e vale a pena separá-las da interpretação alarmista.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **Casamento de ativos e passivos.** Data centers, subestações e terrenos são ativos de longa duração.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: Financiar um ativo de 20 anos com dívidas de 10 ou 30 anos é finanças corporativas básicas, não imprudência.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: Chips são uma história diferente — sua vida útil é debatida, e é aí que a discussão fica interessante.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **Preservação da flexibilidade.** Caixa no balanço é opcionalidade: para aquisições, para recompras durante uma queda, para suportar um ano ruim.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: Esgotá-lo a zero para financiar construções deixaria essas empresas mais frágeis, não menos.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **A matemática ainda funciona — por enquanto.** Tomadores de grau de investimento com fortes classificações de crédito podem captar recursos de longo prazo a taxas que permanecem abaixo do retorno esperado sobre o capital investido, pelo menos nas projeções que sustentam esses programas.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: Se as projeções se mantiverem, a alavancagem é geradora de valor.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **Mecânica fiscal e jurisdicional.** Os juros são dedutíveis; repatriar e aplicar o caixa nem sempre é algo sem atrito.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: A otimização aqui é trivial e legítima.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: O resumo honesto é que tomar emprestado para construir é algo normal para uma indústria intensiva em capital.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: O que há de novo é que *esta* indústria agora é intensiva em capital.

segments.tr: ## O que os investidores de títulos começaram a precificar

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## Os argumentos para preocupação

segments.tr: Se os aceleradores de IA se tornarem funcionalmente obsoletos mais rápido do que os cronogramas supõem, os lucros relatados têm tomado emprestado do futuro — e a dívida contraída contra esses lucros não se ajusta.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **A receita se consolidar mais devagar do que a capacidade é adicionada.** A capacidade está sendo construída à frente da demanda por design; é assim que uma corrida de infraestrutura se parece.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: Mas o abismo entre o gasto e a monetização está sendo financiado atualmente.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: Uma lacuna prolongada transforma uma história de crescimento em um problema de refinanciamento.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **Taxas ou spreads se moverem contra elas no momento errado.** Estes são créditos fortes com fluxo de caixa real.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: Mas os muros de vencimento que estão sendo criados agora serão refinanciados sob condições que ninguém pode prever, e a premissa de que a tecnologia IG sempre encontrará demanda não foi testada neste volume.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## Os argumentos para a calma

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: O contra-argumento não é fraco.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: Os índices de alavancagem na maioria desses emissores permanecem baixos para qualquer padrão corporativo histórico — números de dívida líquida sobre EBITDA que uma concessionária de serviços públicos ou operadora de telecomunicações consideraria invejáveis.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: A cobertura de juros é extraordinária.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: Os negócios que financiam os pagamentos de juros — nuvem, publicidade, software corporativo — estão entre os motores de caixa mais duráveis já construídos e ainda estão crescendo.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: Há também um ativo real ao final disso tudo.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: Diferente da expansão da fibra no final dos anos 1990, que produziu capacidade que ficou inativa por anos, grande parte do processamento atual é consumida na entrega.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: A utilização, onde as empresas a divulgam, tem sido em geral alta.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: A posição razoável não é "esta é uma bolha financiada com dívida" nem "essas empresas podem arcar com qualquer coisa."

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: É que o perfil de risco de um setor inteiro mudou, e o mercado está no meio de sua reprecificação em tempo real.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## O que realmente observar

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr:
Para os leitores que estão acompanhando isso em vez de negociando, um punhado de indicadores traz mais sinal do que os números de capex de manchete:
 point

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr:
- **Fluxo de caixa livre, não fluxo de caixa operacional.** O fluxo de caixa operacional mostra que o negócio é saudável. O fluxo de caixa livre mostra o que resta após a construção.
 point

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr:
- **Mudanças nos cronogramas de depreciação** divulgadas em relatórios — uma extensão da vida útil é um ajuste discreto nos lucros.
 point

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr:
- **A proporção de capex comprometido para discricionário.** Gastos discricionários podem ser cortados em uma desaceleração; compromissos contratuais não.
 point

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr:
- **Comportamento do spread na emissão.** Se novas ofertas são precificadas com uma concessão em relação aos papéis existentes é o veredito ao vivo do mercado.
 point

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr:
- **Divulgação de obrigações de JV, SPV e arrendamentos**, que ficam cada vez mais fora da figura principal da dívida.
 point

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **Qualquer sinal de que os programas de retorno aos acionistas estão sendo reduzidos** — isso seria a administração sinalizando que a matemática do caixa ficou mais apertada do que as orientações implicam.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A linha de fundo

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: A expansão da IA está sendo financiada da maneira como grandes infraestruturas sempre foram financiadas: com o dinheiro de outras pessoas, em prazos longos, contra a demanda projetada.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: Isso não é escandaloso.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: É simplesmente um modelo de negócios diferente daquele ao qual os investidores se acostumaram, com um conjunto diferente de modos de falha.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: As empresas que eram famosas por não ter dívidas agora têm um cronograma de vencimentos.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: Se isso se revelará uma alocação prudente de capital ou uma lição cara depende de uma pergunta que ninguém pode responder ainda — se a receita chegará no mesmo cronograma dos pagamentos de juros.
