in.title: Big Tech Kini Meminjam untuk Membangun: Surat Utang di Balik Boom AI

segments.src: For most of the past two decades, the defining financial fact about America's largest technology companies was how much money they had lying around.
segments.tr: Durante sebagian besar dua dekade terakhir, fakta keuangan yang menentukan tentang perusahaan teknologi terbesar di Amerika adalah seberapa banyak uang tunai yang mereka miliki.

segments.src: Cash piles measured in the hundreds of billions became a running joke on earnings calls and a genuine policy question in Washington.
segments.tr: Tumpukan uang tunai senilai ratusan miliar menjadi lelucon berulang dalam panggilan laba dan pertanyaan kebijakan nyata di Washington.

segments.src: The companies were so liquid that the main debate was what to do with the surplus: buy back stock, pay dividends, or park it offshore.
segments.tr: Perusahaan-perusahaan tersebut sangat likuid sehingga perdebatan utamanya adalah apa yang harus dilakukan dengan surplus tersebut: membeli kembali saham, membayar dividen, atau menyimpannya di luar negeri.

segments.src: That framing is quietly going out of date.
segments.tr: Kerangka berpikir itu secara perlahan mulai usang.

segments.src: The build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure has turned the most cash-generative businesses in the world into some of the largest borrowers in the corporate bond market — not because they are short of money, but because even their extraordinary cash flow no longer covers the bill.
segments.tr: Pembangunan infrastruktur kecerdasan buatan telah mengubah bisnis yang paling menghasilkan uang tunai di dunia menjadi beberapa peminjam terbesar di pasar obligasi korporasi — bukan karena mereka kekurangan uang, tetapi karena bahkan arus kas luar biasa mereka tidak lagi cukup untuk menutup biayanya.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spend
segments.tr: ## Skala pengeluaran

segments.src: Estimates compiled from company guidance and analyst models put combined 2026 capital expenditure across the major hyperscalers at upward of **$750 billion**.
segments.tr: Perkiraan yang dihimpun dari panduan perusahaan dan model analis menempatkan gabungan belanja modal (capex) tahun 2026 di seluruh hyperscaler utama mencapai lebih dari **$750 miliar**.

segments.src: To put that in perspective, it is a figure that would have described the entire capital spending of the S&P 500's industrial sector not long ago.
segments.tr: Sebagai perbandingan, angka tersebut adalah angka yang menggambarkan seluruh belanja modal sektor industri S&P 500 belum lama ini.

segments.src: The more revealing number is the ratio.
segments.tr: Angka yang lebih mengungkapkan adalah rasionya.

segments.src: That spending represents roughly **94% of the group's operating cash flow** — meaning almost every dollar these companies generate from running their existing businesses is being committed to building the next one.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran tersebut mewakili sekitar **94% dari arus kas operasional kelompok tersebut** — artinya hampir setiap dolar yang dihasilkan perusahaan-perusahaan ini dari menjalankan bisnis yang ada berkomitmen untuk membangun bisnis berikutnya.

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: Secara historis, big tech mengonversi arus kas operasional menjadi arus kas bebas dengan tingkat yang nyaman, menyisakan ruang yang cukup untuk pembelian kembali saham dan dividen.

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: Bantalan itu telah menipis secara drastis.

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: Dan karena program pengembalian pemegang saham belum dipotong secara proporsional, kesenjangan tersebut harus diisi dari suatu tempat.

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: Ini diisi dengan utang.

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## $194 miliar dalam enam bulan

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: Penghitungan pasar dari penerbitan investment-grade menunjukkan penerbit teknologi dan komunikasi menjual sekitar **$194 miliar obligasi investment-grade pada paruh pertama tahun 2026 saja** — sebuah tempo yang tidak terbayangkan untuk sektor ini lima tahun lalu, ketika beberapa dari perusahaan ini memegang posisi kas bersih dan menerbitkan utang terutama untuk alasan oportunistik atau pajak.

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: Sekitar **sepertiga dari program capex didanai dengan uang pinjaman**.

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: Ini adalah pergeseran struktural, bukan anomali satu kuartal.

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: Ini mengubah identitas keuangan perusahaan-perusahaan ini: dari compounder mandiri menjadi pembangun yang padat modal dengan jadwal jatuh tempo yang harus dikelola.

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## Mengapa meminjam ketika Anda memiliki uang tunai?

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: Ada beberapa alasan yang dapat dipertahankan, dan alasan-alasan ini perlu dipisahkan dari interpretasi yang mengkhawatirkan.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **Penyelarasan aset-liabilitas.** Pusat data, gardu induk, dan lahan adalah aset berjangka panjang.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: Mendanai aset 20 tahun dengan utang 10 atau 30 tahun adalah keuangan korporasi yang standar, bukan kecerobohan.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: Chip adalah cerita yang berbeda — masa manfaatnya diperdebatkan, dan di situlah argumennya menjadi menarik.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **Menjaga fleksibilitas.** Kas di neraca adalah opsionalitas: untuk akuisisi, untuk pembelian kembali saham saat penurunan, untuk menghadapi tahun yang buruk.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: Mengurasnya hingga nol untuk mendanai konstruksi akan membuat perusahaan-perusahaan ini lebih rentan, bukan sebaliknya.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **Kalkulasinya masih masuk akal — untuk saat ini.** Peminjam berperingkat investment-grade yang kuat dapat menghimpun dana jangka panjang dengan tingkat bunga yang tetap di bawah perkiraan pengembalian atas modal yang diinvestasikan, setidaknya pada proyeksi yang mendasari program-program ini.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: Jika proyeksi tersebut bertahan, laverage bersifat akretif.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **Mekanisme pajak dan yurisdiksi.** Bunga dapat dikurangi dari pajak; merepatriasi dan menyalurkan kas tidak selalu bebas hambatan.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: Optimasi di sini adalah hal yang lumrah dan sah.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: Ringkasan yang jujur adalah bahwa meminjam untuk membangun adalah hal yang normal bagi industri yang padat modal.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: Yang baru adalah bahwa industri *ini* sekarang menjadi padat modal.

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## Apa yang mulai diperhitungkan oleh investor obligasi

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: Pasar kredit telah menyerap pasokan tersebut, tetapi tidak secara gratis.

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr:
Beberapa dinamika terlihat dari bagaimana utang tersebut diperdagangkan dan bagaimana utang tersebut diatur:
 point

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr:
- **Risiko konsentrasi dalam indeks.** Seiring tumbuhnya penerbitan tech, dana investment-grade pasif secara mekanis mengambil lebih banyak paparan terhadap tema tunggal yang berkorelasi tinggi. Seorang investor yang membeli dana obligasi IG luas untuk diversifikasi kini mungkin memegang taruhan signifikan pada ekonomi infrastruktur AI.
 point

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr:
- **Diferensiasi spread yang moderat.** Tidak semua surat berharga hyperscaler diperdagangkan secara serupa. Investor semakin membedakan antar penerbit berdasarkan visibilitas pendapatan yang seharusnya melayani utang tersebut, dan berapa banyak dari capex yang berkomitmen versus diskresioner.
 point

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr:
- **Preferensi kurva.** Permintaan terlihat lebih kuat pada jatuh tempo pendek dan menengah dibandingkan pada jangka sangat panjang, di mana investor diminta untuk menanggung daya tahan permintaan AI dua dan tiga dekade ke depan.
 point

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Struktur di luar obligasi biasa.** Porsi pembangunan yang semakin besar didanai melalui joint venture, special-purpose vehicle (SPV), kredit swasta, dan sewa jangka panjang. Ini belum tentu bermasalah, tetapi membuat laverage neraca utama menjadi gambaran yang tidak lengkap dari total kewajiban.

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: Poin terakhir ini paling penting bagi siapa saja yang mencoba mengukur risiko.

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: Angka pasar obligasi adalah bagian yang terlihat.

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: Jejak pembiayaan penuh — termasuk struktur di luar neraca dan yang didanai mitra — lebih besar dan lebih sulit diukur dari luar.

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## Alasan untuk khawatir

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: Tiga hal harus terbukti benar agar ini berakhir buruk, dan tidak ada satu pun dari hal tersebut yang tidak masuk akal.

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **Asumsi penyusutan terbukti terlalu optimistis.** Beberapa perusahaan memperpanjang perkiraan masa manfaat peralatan server dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, yang menurunkan penyusutan yang dilaporkan dan mempercantik laba.

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: Jika akselerator AI secara fungsional usang lebih cepat daripada yang diperkirakan dalam jadwal, laba yang dilaporkan telah meminjam dari masa depan — dan utang yang ditarik atas laba tersebut tidak menyesuaikan diri.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **Pendapatan masuk lebih lambat daripada kapasitas yang ditambahkan.** Kapasitas dibangun mendahului permintaan secara sengaja; seperti itulah bentuk perlombaan infrastruktur.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: Namun kesenjangan antara pengeluaran dan monetisasi saat ini sedang didanai.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan yang berkepanjangan mengubah cerita pertumbuhan menjadi masalah refinansial.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **Suku bunga atau spread bergerak melawan mereka di saat yang salah.** Ini adalah kredit yang kuat dengan arus kas nyata.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: Namun dinding jatuh tempo yang diciptakan sekarang akan direfinansialkan dalam kondisi yang tidak dapat diprediksi oleh siapa pun, dan asumsi bahwa tech IG akan selalu menemukan pembeli belum teruji pada volume ini.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## Alasan untuk tetap tenang

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: Argumen tandingan tidaklah lemah.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: Rasio laverage pada sebagian besar penerbit ini tetap rendah berdasarkan standar historis korporasi mana pun — angka utang bersih terhadap EBITDA yang akan dianggap iri oleh operator utilitas atau telekomunikasi.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: Cakupan bunga sangat luar biasa.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: Bisnis yang mendanai pembayaran bunga — cloud, periklanan, perangkat lunak enterprise — adalah salah satu mesin kas paling tahan lama yang pernah dibangun, dan mereka masih tumbuh.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: Ada juga aset nyata di akhir semua ini.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: Tidak seperti pembangunan serat optik pada akhir 1990-an, yang menghasilkan kapasitas yang tidak terpakai selama bertahun-tahun, sebagian besar komputasi saat ini langsung dikonsumsi saat disediakan.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: Utilisasi, sejauh yang diungkapkan perusahaan, umumnya tinggi.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: Posisi yang masuk akal bukanlah "ini adalah gelembung yang didanai dengan utang" ataupun "perusahaan-perusahaan ini mampu membeli apa saja."

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: Ini adalah bahwa profil risiko dari seluruh sektor telah berubah, dan pasar sedang berada di tengah-tengah penyesuaian harga secara real-time.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## Apa yang sebenarnya harus dipantau

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr:
Bagi pembaca yang memantau hal ini daripada memperdagangkannya, sejumlah indikator memberi lebih banyak sinyal daripada angka capex utama:
 point

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr:
- **Arus kas bebas, bukan arus kas operasional.** Arus kas operasional memberi tahu Anda bahwa bisnis sehat. Arus kas bebas memberi tahu Anda apa yang tersisa setelah pembangunan.
 point

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr:
- **Perubahan pada jadwal penyusutan** yang diungkapkan dalam laporan keuangan — perpanjangan masa manfaat adalah penyesuaian laba secara diam-diam.

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr:
- **Rasio capex berkomitmen terhadap diskresioner.** Pengeluaran diskresioner dapat dipotong saat penurunan; komitmen kontraktual tidak bisa.
 point

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr:
- **Perilaku spread saat penerbitan.** Apakah kesepakatan baru diberi harga dengan konsesi relatif terhadap surat berharga yang ada adalah keputusan langsung dari pasar.
 point

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr:
- **Pengungkapan kewajiban JV, SPV, dan sewa**, yang semakin banyak berada di luar angka utang utama.
 point

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **Tanda-tanda apa pun bahwa program pengembalian pemegang saham dipangkas** — itu akan menjadi sinyal dari manajemen bahwa kalkulasi kas telah menjadi lebih ketat dari yang diindikasikan panduan.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: Pembangunan AI didanai dengan cara yang sama seperti infrastruktur besar selalu didanai: dengan uang orang lain, dalam jangka waktu panjang, terhadap proyeksi permintaan.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: Isunya bukan hal yang skandal.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: Ini hanyalah model bisnis yang berbeda dari yang biasa dihadapi investor, dengan serangkaian mode kegagalan yang berbeda.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: Perusahaan yang terkenal tidak memiliki utang kini memiliki jadwal jatuh tempo.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: Apakah itu ternyata menjadi alokasi modal yang bijaksana atau pelajaran yang mahal bergantung pada pertanyaan yang belum bisa dijawab oleh siapa pun — apakah pendapatan tiba pada jadwal yang sama dengan pembayaran bunga.

ja.title: ビッグテックは今や建設のために社債を発行する：AIブームの陰に隠れた債券の発行ラッシュ

segments.src: For most of the past two decades, the defining financial fact about America's largest technology companies was how much money they had lying around.
segments.tr: 過去20年間の大部分において、アメリカの最大手テクノロジー企業に関する決定的な財務上の事実は、彼らがどれほど多くの手元資金を保有しているかということでした。

segments.src: Cash piles measured in the hundreds of billions became a running joke on earnings calls and a genuine policy question in Washington.
segments.tr: 数千億ドル規模の現金資産は、決算発表におけるお決まりのジョークとなり、ワシントンにおいては真剣な政策上の議論の対象となりました。

segments.src: The companies were so liquid that the main debate was what to do with the surplus: buy back stock, pay dividends, or park it offshore.
segments.tr: 企業は非常に高い流動性を備えていたため、主な議論は「余剰資金をどうするか（自社株買いか、配当金支払いか、あるいはオフショアに保持するか）」という点にありました。

segments.src: That framing is quietly going out of date.
segments.tr: その前提が、静かに時代遅れになりつつあります。

segments.src: The build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure has turned the most cash-generative businesses in the world into some of the largest borrowers in the corporate bond market — not because they are short of money, but because even their extraordinary cash flow no longer covers the bill.
segments.tr: 人工知能（AI）インフラの構築により、世界で最もキャッシュを生み出すビジネスが、社債市場における最大級の借り手へと変貌を望みつつあります。それは資金が不足しているからではなく、彼らの異例なキャッシュフローをもってしても、莫大な費用を賄いきれなくなったからです。

segments.src: ## The scale of the spend
segments.tr: ## 支出の規模

segments.src: Estimates compiled from company guidance and analyst models put combined 2026 capital expenditure across the major hyperscalers at upward of **$750 billion**.
segments.tr: 企業のガイダンスやアナリストのモデルからまとめられた予測によると、主要ハイパースケーラー全体における2026年の設備投資額（Capex）の合計は**7,500億ドル**以上に達すると見込まれています。

segments.src: To put that in perspective, it is a figure that would have described the entire capital spending of the S&P 500's industrial sector not long ago.
segments.tr: 分かりやすく言うと、この数字は少し前までのS&P 500の産業セクター全体の設備投資額に匹敵する規模です。

segments.src: The more revealing number is the ratio.
segments.tr: より雄弁に現状を物語っているのはその比率です。

segments.src: That spending represents roughly **94% of the group's operating cash flow** — meaning almost every dollar these companies generate from running their existing businesses is being committed to building the next one.
segments.tr: この支出は、グループ全体の**営業キャッシュフローの約94%**に相当します。つまり、これらの企業が既存の事業を運営することで得ている1ドルのほぼすべてが、次の事業の構築に投入されていることを意味します。

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: 歴史的に、ビッグテックは営業キャッシュフローを順調にフリーキャッシュフローへと変換し、自社株買いや配当のための十分な余力を残してきました。

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: そのクッションは劇的に薄くなっています。

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: そして、株主還元プログラムが比例して削減されていないため、そのギャップはどこかで埋めなければなりません。

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: それは負債によって埋められています。

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## 6ヶ月で1,940億ドル

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: 投資適格債の発行に関する市場の集計データによると、テクノロジーおよび通信セクターの発行体は**2026年上半期だけで約1,940億ドルの投資適格債**を売却しました。これは5年前の同セクターでは考えられなかったペースです。当時、これらの企業の多くは実質無借金であり、主に機会主義的な目的や節税目的で債券を発行していました。

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: 設備投資計画の**約3分の1が借入金によって賄われています**。

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: これは単一四半期のイレギュラーな事象ではなく、構造的なシフトです。

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: 財務面で見れば、これらの企業の本質が変わりました。自己資金で成長するコンパウンダーから、満期スケジュールを管理しなければならない資本集約型の建設業者へと変化したのです。

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## キャッシュがあるのになぜ借り入れるのか？

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: それには正当化できる理由がいくつかあり、警戒感を煽る解釈とは分けて考える価値があります。

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **アセット・ライアビリティ・マッチング（資産・負債の期間マッチング）。** データセンター、変電所、土地は長期にわたって使用される資産です。

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: 20年耐用年数の資産を10年または30年の社債で調達することは、コーポレートファイナンスの基本であり、無謀な行為ではありません。

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: 半導体は話が別です。その有用な耐用年数には異論があり、ここから議論が面白くなります。

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **柔軟性の維持。** 貸借対照表上の現金は選択肢（オプショナリティ）です。買収のため、相場下落時の自社株買いのため、あるいは業績不振の年を乗り切るためのものです。

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: 建設資金のためにそれを底につくまで使い果たすことは、企業をより脆弱にするだけであり、健全化にはつながりません。

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **計算は成立している（今のところ）。** 高い格付けを持つ投資適格の借り手は、少なくともこれらの計画の基礎となる予測においては、投下資本利益率の予想を下回る利率で長期資金を調達できます。

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: 予測が維持される限り、レバレッジは利益を高めます。

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **税制および法域のメカニズム。** 支払利息は損金算入可能です。一方、国外の現金を本国に還流して運用することは、常にスムーズにいくとは限りません。

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: ここでの最適化は極めて日常的であり合法的なものです。

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: 誠実な結論を言えば、建設のために借入を行うことは、資本集約型産業においては正常な行動です。

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: 新しいのは、*この*産業が今や資本集約型になったという点です。

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## 債券投資家が織り込み始めたもの

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: 債券市場はその供給を吸収してきましたが、無償ではありません。

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr:
債券がどのように取引され、どのように構造化されているかにおいて、いくつかの動向が見られます。
 point

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr:
- **インデックスにおける集中リスク。** テック企業の発行が増加するにつれて、パッシブ型の投資適格ファンドは、高度に連動した単一のテーマに対して機械的にリスクエクスポージャーを高めています。分散投資のために広範な投資適格債ファンドを購入した投資家が、現在ではAIインフラの経済性に対して実質的に大きな賭けに出ている可能性があります。
 point

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr:
- **スプレッドの緩やかな差別化。** すべてのハイパースケーラーの社債が同様に取引されているわけではありません。投資家は、債務履行に充てられる見込みの収益の透明性や、設備投資のうち確定的なものと任意（選択的）なものの比率に基づいて、発行体をますます厳しく選別しています。
 point

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr:
- **イールドカーブの選好。** 超長期債に比べて、短期および中期の満期債に対する需要が顕著に堅調です。超長期債では、投資家は2〜3十年先のAI需要の持続性を引き受けるよう求められるためです。
 point

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **通常の社債を超えた構造。** 建設の資金調達において、ジョイントベンチャー、特別目的会社（SPV）、プライベートクレジット、長期リースなどの割合が増加しています。これらは必ずしも問題ではありませんが、表面上の貸借対照表上のレバレッジだけでは全負債の全容を把握できない要因となっています。

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: この最後のポイントは、リスクの規模を推し量ろうとする誰にとっても最も重要です。

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: 社債市場の数字は目に見える部分に過ぎません。

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: オフバランスシート構造やパートナー資金調達による構造を含む資金調達の全体像はより大きく、外部から正確に測定することは困難です。

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## 懸念される根拠

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: これが悪い結末を迎えるためには、3つの条件が成立する必要がありますが、どれもあり得ない話ではありません。

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **減価償却の前提が楽観的すぎることが判明する。** 近年、複数の企業がサーバー設備の想定耐用年数を延長しました。これにより報告される減価償却費が抑えられ、利益が押し上げられます。

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: もしAIアクセラレータが想定スケジュールよりも早く機能的に陳腐化した場合、報告された利益は将来から前借りしていたことになり、それらの利益を担保にして調達した負債は調整されません。

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **収益化の速度が、キャパシティの追加速度よりも遅い。** 需要に先駆けてキャパシティを構築するのは意図的な設計であり、インフラ競争とはそのようなものです。

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: しかし、支出と収益化の間のギャップは現在、借入によって賄われています。

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: このギャップが長期化すると、成長の物語がリファイナンスの問題へと変貌します。

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **不適切なタイミングで金利やスプレッドが逆風となる。** これらは実質的なキャッシュフローを持つ優良な信用力を持った企業です。

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: しかし、現在作られている満期の壁は、誰にも予測できない条件の下でリファイナンスされることになります。投資適格テック債に常に買い手が存在するという前提は、この規模においては未検証です。

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## 冷静さを保つべき根拠

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: 反論も決して弱くはありません。

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: これらの発行体の大部分におけるレバレッジ比率は、過去のあらゆる企業基準から見ても依然として低い水準です。電力会社や通信事業者がうらやむような「純負債 / EBITDA」の数値です。

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: インタレスト・カバレッジ・レシオ（支払利息補償倍率）は極めて良好です。

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: 利払いを支えるビジネス（クラウド、広告、エンタープライズ向けソフトウェア）は、これまで構築された中で最も持続可能なキャッシュ生成エンジンであり、現在も成長を続けています。

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: また、この投資の先には実体資産が存在します。

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: 1990年代後半のファイバー網構築（何年も未使用のまま放置された容量を生み出した）とは異なり、今日のコンピューティング能力の多くは提供と同時に消費されています。

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: 企業が公表している稼働率は、全般的に高い水準を維持しています。

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: 妥当な見解は、「これは負債で賄われたバブルである」でも「これらの企業は何でも負担できる」でもありません。

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: 「セクター全体のリスクプロファイルが変化し、市場がそれをリアルタイムで再評価（リプライシング）している最中である」という解釈です。

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## 実際に注視すべきポイント

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr:
トレードするためではなく追跡している読者にとって、表面上の設備投資額よりもシグナルとなる指標がいくつかあります。
 point

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr:
- **営業キャッシュフローではなく、フリーキャッシュフロー。** 営業キャッシュフローは事業が健全であることを示します。フリーキャッシュフローは、建設の後に何が残るかを示します。
 point

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr:
- **有価証券報告書等で開示される減価償却スケジュールの変更。** 耐用年数の延長は、静かな利益調整を意味します。
 point

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr:
- **確定的な設備投資と任意（選択的）な設備投資の比率。** 選択的支出は景気後退時に削減できますが、契約上のコミットメントは削減できません。
 point

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr:
- **発行時のスプレッドの挙動。** 新規案件が既存の社債に対してスプレッドを上乗せ（コンセッション）して価格決定されるかどうかは、市場の生の判定です。
 point

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr:
- **JV、SPV、リース義務の開示。** これらは表面上の負債額の外側に位置することが増えています。
 point

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **株主還元プログラムの縮小を示す兆候。** それは、キャッシュの計算がガイダンスの示唆する以上に厳しくなったという経営陣からのシグナルになります。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: AIのインフラ構築は、大規模なインフラが常に資金調達されてきた方法、つまり他人の資金を使い、長期にわたって、予測される需要に基づいて調達されています。

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: それはスキャンダラスなことではありません。

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: 単に投資家が慣れ親しんでいたものとは異なるビジネスモデルであり、異なる失敗モード（リスクのパターン）が存在するというだけのことです。

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: 無借金で有名だった企業に、今や社債の満期スケジュールが存在します。

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.

de.title: Big Tech nimmt jetzt Kredite auf, um zu bauen: Die Anleiherechnung hinter dem KI-Boom

segments.src: For most of the past two decades, the defining financial fact about America's largest technology companies was how much money they had lying around.
segments.tr: In den letzten zwei Jahrzehnten war die prägende finanzielle Tatsache über Amerikas größte Technologieunternehmen, wie viel Geld sie herumliegen hatten.

segments.src: Cash piles measured in the hundreds of billions became a running joke on earnings calls and a genuine policy question in Washington.
segments.tr: Bargeldreserven in Hunderte von Milliarden Höhe wurden zu einem Dauerbrenner bei Ergebnispräsentationen und zu einer echten politischen Frage in Washington.

segments.src: The companies were so liquid that the main debate was what to do with the surplus: buy back stock, pay dividends, or park it offshore.
segments.tr: Die Unternehmen waren so liquide, dass die Hauptdebatte darin bestand, was mit dem Überschuss geschehen sollte: Aktien zurückkaufen, Dividenden zahlen oder im Ausland parken.

segments.src: That framing is quietly going out of date.
segments.tr: Diese Sichtweise veraltet leise.

segments.src: The build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure has turned the most cash-generative businesses in the world into some of the largest borrowers in the corporate bond market — not because they are short of money, but because even their extraordinary cash flow no longer covers the bill.
segments.tr: Der Aufbau der Infrastruktur für künstliche Intelligenz hat die bargeldgenerierendsten Unternehmen der Welt in einige der größten Kreditnehmer auf dem Markt für Unternehmensanleihen verwandelt – nicht weil ihnen das Geld fehlt, sondern weil selbst ihr außergewöhnlicher Cashflow die Rechnung nicht mehr deckt.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spend
segments.tr: ## Das Ausmaß der Ausgaben

segments.src: Estimates compiled from company guidance and analyst models put combined 2026 capital expenditure across the major hyperscalers at upward of **$750 billion**.
segments.tr: Schätzungen aus Unternehmensprognosen und Analystenmodellen beziffern die kumulierten Investitionsausgaben (Capex) der großen Hyperscaler für 2026 auf über **750 Milliarden Dollar**.

segments.src: To put that in perspective, it is a figure that would have described the entire capital spending of the S&P 500's industrial sector not long ago.
segments.tr: Um das zu verdeutlichen: Das ist eine Zahl, die noch vor kurzem die gesamten Investitionsausgaben des gesamten Industriesektors des S&P 500 beschrieben hätte.

segments.src: The more revealing number is the ratio.
segments.tr: Die aufschlussreichere Zahl ist das Verhältnis.

segments.src: That spending represents roughly **94% of the group's operating cash flow** — meaning almost every dollar these companies generate from running their existing businesses is being committed to building the next one.
segments.tr: Diese Ausgaben entsprechen etwa **94 % des operativen Cashflows der Gruppe** – was bedeutet, dass fast jeder Dollar, den diese Unternehmen aus dem Betrieb ihrer bestehenden Geschäfte generieren, für den Aufbau des nächsten eingesetzt wird.

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: Historisch gesehen wandelte Big Tech den operativen Cashflow in einem komfortablen Tempo in freien Cashflow um, was reichlich Raum für Aktienrückkäufe und Dividenden ließ.

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: Kissen ist dramatisch dünner geworden.

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: Und da die Programme für Aktionärsrenditen nicht proportional gekürzt wurden, muss die Lücke irgendwo gefüllt werden.

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: Sie wird mit Schulden gefüllt.

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## 194 Milliarden Dollar in sechs Monaten

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: Marktzählungen über Emissionen von Investment-Grade-Anleihen deuten darauf hin, dass Technologie- und Kommunikationsemittenten **allein in der ersten Hälfte des Jahres 2026 Investment-Grade-Anleihen im Wert von etwa 194 Milliarden Dollar** verkauft haben – ein Tempo, das für diesen Sektor vor fünf Jahren undenkbar gewesen wäre, als mehrere dieser Firmen Nettokassenpositionen hielten und Schulden hauptsächlich aus opportunistischen oder steuerlichen Gründen aufnahmen.

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: Etwa **ein Drittel des Capex-Programms wird mit geliehenem Geld finanziert**.

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: Das ist ein struktureller Wandel, keine Anomalie eines einzelnen Quartals.

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: Es verändert das, was diese Unternehmen finanziell gesehen sind: von sich selbst finanzierenden Zinseszins-Generatoren hin zu kapitalintensiven Bauherren mit einem zu verwaltenden Fälligkeitsplan.

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## Warum Kredite aufnehmen, wenn man das Geld hat?

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: Es gibt mehrere vertretbare Gründe, und es lohnt sich, sie von der alarmierenden Interpretation zu trennen.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **Fristenkongruenz von Aktiva und Passiva (Asset-Liability Matching).** Rechenzentren, Umspannwerke und Grundstücke sind langlebige Vermögenswerte.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: Die Finanzierung eines 20-jährigen Vermögenswerts mit 10- oder 30-jährigen Schulden ist Lehrbuch-Corporate-Finance, keine Leichtsinnigkeit.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: Chips sind eine andere Geschichte – ihre Nutzungsdauer ist umstritten, und hier wird das Argument interessant.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **Flexibilität wahren.** Bargeld in der Bilanz ist eine Option: für Übernahmen, für Rückkäufe während eines Kursrückgangs, um ein schlechtes Jahr zu überstehen.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: Es auf Null abzubauen, um den Bau zu finanzieren, würde diese Firmen fragiler machen, nicht weniger.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **Die Mathematik geht immer noch auf – vorerst.** Investment-Grade-Kreditnehmer mit starken Ratings können langfristiges Geld zu Zinssätzen aufnehmen, die unter ihrer erwarteten Kapitalrendite liegen, zumindest nach den Projektionen, die diesen Programmen zugrunde liegen.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: Wenn die Projektionen halten, wirkt sich die Verschuldung gewinnsteigernd aus.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **Steuer- und Zuständigkeitsmechanismen.** Zinsen sind steuerlich absetzbar; die Repatriierung und der Einsatz von Barmitteln verläuft nicht immer reibungslos.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: Die Optimierung hier ist alltäglich und legitim.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: Die ehrliche Zusammenfassung ist, dass die Aufnahme von Krediten für den Aufbau einer kapitalintensiven Branche etwas Normales ist.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: Neu ist, dass *diese* Branche jetzt kapitalintensiv ist.

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## Was Anleiheinvestoren begonnen haben einzupreisen

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: Die Kreditmärkte haben das Angebot absorbiert, aber nicht umsonst.

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr: Einige Dynamiken zeigen sich darin, wie die Schulden gehandelt und wie sie strukturiert werden:

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr: - **Konzentrationsrisiko im Index.** Mit zunehmenden Tech-Emissionen gehen passive Investment-Grade-Fonds mechanisch ein größeres Risiko gegenüber einem einzigen, stark korrelierten Thema ein. Ein Anleger, der einen breiten IG-Anleihenfonds zur Diversifizierung gekauft hat, hält nun möglicherweise eine bedeutende Wette auf die Ökonomie der KI-Infrastruktur.

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr: - **Geringe Spread-Differenzierung.** Nicht alle Hyperscaler-Papiere werden gleich gehandelt. Anleger unterscheiden zunehmend zwischen Emittenten auf der Grundlage der Sichtbarkeit der Einnahmen, die die Schulden bedienen sollen, und danach, wie viel des Capex gebunden im Vergleich zu diskretionär ist.

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr: - **Kurvenpräferenz.** Die Nachfrage war bei kürzeren und mittleren Laufzeiten spürbar fester als am ganz langen Ende, wo Anleger aufgefordert werden, die Dauerhaftigkeit der KI-Nachfrage in zwei und drei Jahrzehnten abzusichern.

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Strukturen jenseits einfacher Anleihen.** Ein wachsender Anteil des Aufbaus wird über Joint Ventures, Zweckgesellschaften (SPVs), Privatkredite und langfristige Leasingverträge finanziert. Diese sind nicht zwingend problematisch, machen aber die bilanzielle Verschuldung zu einem unvollständigen Bild der Gesamtverbindlichkeiten.

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: Dieser letzte Punkt ist am wichtigsten für jeden, der versucht, das Risiko einzuschätzen.

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: Die Zahl des Anleihenmarktes ist der sichtbare Teil.

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: Der gesamte Finanzierungsfußabdruck – einschließlich außerbilanzieller und partnerfinanzierter Strukturen – ist größer und von außen schwerer zu messen.

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## Die Gründe zur Sorge

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: Drei Dinge müssten zutreffen, damit dies böse endet, und keines davon ist weit hergeholt.

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **Abschreibungsannahmen erweisen sich als optimistisch.** Mehrere Firmen haben in den letzten Jahren die angenommene Nutzungsdauer von Serverhardware verlängert, was die ausgewiesenen Abschreibungen senkt und die Gewinne schönt.

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: Wenn KI-Beschleuniger schneller funktionell veralten als angenommen, haben die ausgewiesenen Gewinne aus der Zukunft geliehen – und die gegen diese Gewinne aufgenommenen Schulden passen sich nicht an.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **Einnahmen stellen sich langsamer ein als Kapazitäten aufgebaut werden.** Kapazität wird konstruktionsbedingt im Vorlauf zur Nachfrage aufgebaut; so sieht ein Infrastruktur-Wettlauf aus.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: Aber die Lücke zwischen Ausgaben und Monetarisierung wird derzeit finanziert.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: Eine anhaltende Lücke verwandelt eine Wachstumsstory in ein Refinanzierungsproblem.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **Zinsen oder Spreads entwickeln sich im falschen Moment gegen sie.** Dies sind starke Schuldner mit realem Cashflow.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: Aber die Fälligkeitsstrukturen, die jetzt geschaffen werden, werden unter Bedingungen refinanziert, die niemand vorhersagen kann, und die Annahme, dass IG-Tech immer Abnehmer findet, ist bei diesem Volumen ungetestet.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## Die Gründe zur Ruhe

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: Das Gegenargument ist nicht schwach.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: Die Verschuldungsquoten bei den meisten dieser Emittenten bleiben nach jedem historischen Unternehmensstandard niedrig – Nettoverschuldungs-zu-EBITDA-Zahlen, die ein Versorgungs- oder Telekommunikationsunternehmen als beneidenswert betrachten würde.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: Die Zinsdeckung ist außergewöhnlich.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: Die Unternehmen, die die Zinszahlungen finanzieren – Cloud, Werbung, Unternehmenssoftware – gehören zu den dauerhaftesten Cash-Maschinen, die je gebaut wurden, und sie wachsen immer noch.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: Am Ende steht auch ein realer Vermögenswert.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: Anders als beim Glasfaseraufbau Ende der 1990er Jahre, der Kapazitäten schuf, die jahrelang ungenutzt blieben, wird ein Großteil der heutigen Rechenleistung direkt bei Lieferung verbraucht.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: Die Auslastung war, wo Unternehmen sie offenlegen, im Allgemeinen hoch.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: Die vernünftige Haltung ist weder „das ist eine mit Schulden finanzierte Blase“ noch „diese Unternehmen können sich alles leisten“.

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: Sie besteht darin, dass sich das Risikoprofil eines gesamten Sektors verändert hat und der Markt mitten darin ist, es in Echtzeit neu zu bewerten.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## Worauf man tatsächlich achten sollte

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr: Für Leser, die dies verfolgen, anstatt damit zu handeln, enthalten eine Handvoll Indikatoren mehr Signal als die reinen Capex-Zahlen:

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr: - **Freier Cashflow, nicht operativer Cashflow.** Der operative Cashflow zeigt Ihnen, dass das Geschäft gesund ist. Der freie Cashflow zeigt Ihnen, was nach dem Aufbau übrig bleibt.

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr: - **Änderungen der Abschreibungspläne**, die in Berichten offengelegt werden – eine Verlängerung der Nutzungsdauer ist eine stille Gewinnanpassung.

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr: - **Das Verhältnis von gebundenem zu diskretionärem Capex.** Diskretionäre Ausgaben können in einem Abschwung gekürzt werden; vertragliche Verpflichtungen nicht.

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr: - **Spread-Verhalten bei Emission.** Ob neue Transaktionen mit einem Abschlag gegenüber bestehenden Papieren eingepreist werden, ist das Live-Urteil des Marktes.

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr: - **Offenlegung von JV-, SPV- und Leasingverbindlichkeiten**, die zunehmend außerhalb der primären Schuldenzahl liegen.

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **Jedes Zeichen, dass Aktionärsrenditeprogramme gekürzt werden** – das wäre ein Signal des Managements, dass die Geldrechnung enger geworden ist, als die Prognosen vermuten lassen.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: Der KI-Aufbau wird so finanziert, wie große Infrastruktur schon immer finanziert wurde: mit dem Geld anderer Leute, über lange Zeiträume, gegen prognostizierte Nachfrage.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: Das ist nicht skandalös.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: Es ist einfach ein anderes Geschäftsmodell als das, an das sich Anleger gewöhnt haben, mit anderen Fehlermöglichkeiten.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: Die Unternehmen, die dafür bekannt waren, keine Schulden zu haben, haben jetzt einen Fälligkeitsplan.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: Ob sich das als umsichtige Kapitalallokation oder als teure Lektion herausstellt, hängt von einer Frage ab, die noch niemand beantworten kann – ob die Einnahmen im gleichen Zeitrahmen eintreffen wie die Zinszahlungen.

segments.tr: Khoản chi tiêu đó chiếm khoảng **94% dòng tiền hoạt động của nhóm** — nghĩa là hầu như mỗi đô la các công ty này tạo ra từ việc vận hành doanh nghiệp hiện tại đang được cam kết để xây dựng doanh nghiệp tiếp theo.

segments.src: Historically, big tech converted operating cash flow into free cash flow at a comfortable clip, leaving ample room for buybacks and dividends.
segments.tr: Trong lịch sử, Big Tech chuyển đổi dòng tiền hoạt động thành dòng tiền tự do ở mức rất thoải mái, để lại không gian rộng lớn cho việc mua lại cổ phiếu và trả cổ tức.

segments.src: That cushion has thinned dramatically.
segments.tr: Lớp đệm đó đã mỏng đi một cách đáng kể.

segments.src: And because shareholder return programs have not been cut proportionally, the gap has to be filled somewhere.
segments.tr: Và bởi vì các chương trình hoàn trả cho cổ đông không bị cắt giảm tương ứng, khoảng trống phải được bù đắp từ đâu đó.

segments.src: It is being filled with debt.
segments.tr: Nó đang được bù đắp bằng nợ.

segments.src: ## $194 billion in six months
segments.tr: ## $194 billion trong sáu tháng

segments.src: Market tallies of investment-grade issuance suggest technology and communications issuers sold on the order of **$194 billion of investment-grade bonds in the first half of 2026 alone** — a pace that would have been unthinkable for this sector five years ago, when several of these firms carried net cash positions and issued debt mainly for opportunistic or tax reasons.
segments.tr: Thống kê thị trường về đợt phát hành cấp đầu tư gợi ý rằng các bên phát hành thuộc lĩnh vực công nghệ và truyền thông đã bán khoảng **$194 billion trái phiếu cấp đầu tư chỉ trong nửa đầu năm 2026** — một tốc độ không thể tưởng tượng nổi đối với ngành này năm năm trước, khi nhiều công ty trong số này nắm giữ vị thế tiền mặt ròng và phát hành nợ chủ yếu vì lý do cơ hội hoặc thuế.

segments.src: Roughly **a third of the capex program is being funded with borrowed money**.
segments.tr: Khoảng **một phần ba chương trình capex đang được tài trợ bằng tiền vay**.

segments.src: That is a structural shift, not a one-quarter anomaly.
segments.tr: Đó là một sự dịch chuyển cơ cấu, không phải là bất thường của riêng một quý.

segments.src: It changes what these companies are, financially speaking: from self-funding compounders into capital-intensive builders with a maturity schedule to manage.
segments.tr: Nó thay đổi bản chất tài chính của các công ty này: từ các cỗ máy tự tích lũy tăng trưởng thành những nhà kiến tạo thâm dụng vốn với một lịch trình đáo hạn cần quản lý.

segments.src: ## Why borrow when you have the cash?
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lại vay khi bạn đã có tiền mặt?

segments.src: There are several defensible reasons, and they are worth separating from the alarming interpretation.
segments.tr: Có một số lý do hợp lý, và chúng đáng được tách biệt khỏi giải thích mang tính báo động.

segments.src: **Asset-liability matching.** Data centers, substations, and land are long-lived assets.
segments.tr: **Cân đối tài sản - nợ (Asset-liability matching).** Trung tâm dữ liệu, trạm biến áp và đất đai là các tài sản dài hạn.

segments.src: Funding a 20-year asset with 10- or 30-year debt is textbook corporate finance, not recklessness.
segments.tr: Tài trợ cho một tài sản 20 năm bằng khoản nợ 10 hoặc 30 năm là tài chính doanh nghiệp bài bản, không phải sự liều lĩnh.

segments.src: Chips are a different story — their useful life is contested, and that is where the argument gets interesting.
segments.tr: Chip lại là một câu chuyện khác — tuổi thọ hữu ích của chúng vẫn gây tranh cãi, và đó là nơi cuộc tranh luận trở nên thú vị.

segments.src: **Preserving flexibility.** Cash on the balance sheet is optionality: for acquisitions, for buybacks during a drawdown, for weathering a bad year.
segments.tr: **Duy trì sự linh hoạt.** Tiền mặt trên bảng cân đối kế toán là quyền lựa chọn: cho các thương vụ M&A, cho việc mua lại cổ phiếu trong đợt sụt giảm, để vượt qua một năm khó khăn.

segments.src: Draining it to zero to fund construction would leave these firms more fragile, not less.
segments.tr: Rút cạn nó về số 0 để tài trợ xây dựng sẽ khiến các công ty này trở nên mong mong hơn, chứ không bớt đi.

segments.src: **The math still works — for now.** Investment-grade borrowers with strong ratings can raise long-term money at rates that remain below their expected return on invested capital, at least on the projections underpinning these programs.
segments.tr: **Tính toán vẫn có hiệu quả — vào lúc này.** Các bên vay cấp đầu tư có xếp hạng tín nhiệm cao có thể huy động vốn dài hạn với lãi suất vẫn thấp hơn tỷ suất sinh lời dự kiến trên vốn đầu tư, ít nhất là theo các dự báo làm cơ sở cho các chương trình này.

segments.src: If the projections hold, leverage is accretive.
segments.tr: Nếu các dự báo giữ nguyên, đòn bẩy sẽ giúp gia tăng giá trị.

segments.src: **Tax and jurisdictional mechanics.** Interest is deductible; repatriating and deploying cash is not always frictionless.
segments.tr: **Cơ chế thuế và tài chính giữa các quốc gia.** Lãi vay được trừ thuế; việc chuyển tiền về nước và triển khai tiền mặt không phải lúc nào cũng thuận lợi.

segments.src: The optimization here is mundane and legitimate.
segments.tr: Sự tối ưu hóa ở đây là bình thường và hợp pháp.

segments.src: The honest summary is that borrowing to build is a normal thing for a capital-intensive industry to do.
segments.tr: Tóm tắt trung thực là việc vay nợ để xây dựng là điều bình thường đối với một ngành thâm dụng vốn.

segments.src: What is new is that *this* industry is now capital-intensive.
segments.tr: Điểm mới là ngành *này* hiện đã trở nên thâm dụng vốn.

segments.src: ## What bond investors have started pricing in
segments.tr: ## Những gì nhà đầu tư trái phiếu đã bắt đầu định giá

segments.src: Credit markets have absorbed the supply, but not for free.
segments.tr: Thị trường tín dụng đã hấp thụ nguồn cung, nhưng không phải miễn phí.

segments.src: A few dynamics are visible in how the debt is trading and how it is being structured:
segments.tr: Một vài động lực được thể hiện qua cách nợ đang được giao dịch và cấu trúc:

segments.src: - **Concentration risk in the index.** As tech issuance grows, passive investment-grade funds are mechanically taking on more exposure to a single, highly correlated theme. An investor who bought a broad IG bond fund for diversification may now hold a meaningful bet on AI infrastructure economics.
segments.tr: - **Rủi ro tập trung trong chỉ số.** Khi lượng phát hành công nghệ tăng lên, các quỹ đầu tư cấp đầu tư thụ động đang tiếp nhận nhiều rủi ro hơn một cách máy móc đối với một chủ đề duy nhất có độ tương quan cao. Một nhà đầu tư mua quỹ trái phiếu IG rộng lớn để đa dạng hóa giờ đây có thể đang nắm giữ một khoản đặt cược đáng kể vào kinh tế hạ tầng AI.

segments.src: - **Modest spread differentiation.** Not all hyperscaler paper trades alike. Investors are increasingly distinguishing between issuers based on the visibility of the revenue that is supposed to service the debt, and on how much of the capex is committed versus discretionary.
segments.tr: - **Sự phân hóa chênh lệch giá (spread) khiêm tốn.** Không phải tất cả giấy tờ có giá của hyperscaler đều giao dịch giống nhau. Các nhà đầu tư đang ngày càng phân biệt giữa các bên phát hành dựa trên mức độ rõ ràng của doanh thu dự kiến sẽ trả nợ, và dựa trên bao nhiêu phần capex là cam kết so với tự quyết.

segments.src: - **Curve preference.** Demand has been noticeably firmer at shorter and intermediate maturities than at the very long end, where investors are being asked to underwrite the durability of AI demand two and three decades out.
segments.tr: - **Ưu tiên đường cong kỳ hạn.** Cầu đối với các kỳ hạn ngắn và trung hạn rõ ràng vững chắc hơn so với kỳ hạn rất dài, nơi các nhà đầu tư được yêu cầu bảo lãnh cho độ bền vững của cầu AI trong hai đến ba thập kỷ tới.

segments.src: - **Structures beyond plain bonds.** A growing share of the build is being financed through joint ventures, special-purpose vehicles, private credit, and long-dated leases. These are not necessarily problematic, but they make headline balance-sheet leverage an incomplete picture of total obligations.
segments.tr: - **Cấu trúc vượt ra ngoài trái phiếu thông thường.** Một phần ngày càng tăng của dự án xây dựng đang được tài trợ thông qua liên doanh, công ty mục đích đặc biệt (SPV), tín dụng tư nhân và hợp đồng thuê dài hạn. Những cấu trúc này không nhất thiết mang lại rủi ro, nhưng chúng khiến đòn bẩy hiển thị trên bảng cân đối kế toán trở thành một bức tranh không đầy đủ về tổng nghĩa vụ trả nợ.

segments.src: That last point matters most for anyone trying to size the risk.
segments.tr: Điểm cuối cùng đó quan trọng nhất đối với bất kỳ ai đang cố gắng đánh giá rủi ro.

segments.src: The bond market number is the visible part.
segments.tr: Con số trên thị trường trái phiếu là phần nhìn thấy được.

segments.src: The full financing footprint — including off-balance-sheet and partner-funded structures — is larger and harder to measure from the outside.
segments.tr: Toàn bộ dấu chân tài chính — bao gồm các cấu trúc ngoại bảng và do đối tác tài trợ — lớn hơn và khó đo lường hơn từ bên ngoài.

segments.src: ## The case for concern
segments.tr: ## Lý do để lo ngại

segments.src: Three things would have to be true for this to end badly, and none of them are far-fetched.
segments.tr: Ba điều sẽ phải xảy ra để điều này kết thúc một cách tồi tệ, và không có điều nào trong số đó là xa vời.

segments.src: Depreciation assumptions prove optimistic.** Several firms extended the assumed useful life of server equipment in recent years, which lowers reported depreciation and flatters earnings.
segments.tr: **Giả định khấu hao hóa ra quá khả quan.** Một số công ty đã kéo dài tuổi thọ hữu ích giả định của thiết bị máy chủ trong những năm gần đây, giúp giảm khấu hao ghi nhận và làm đẹp lợi nhuận.

segments.src: If AI accelerators are functionally obsolete faster than the schedules assume, reported profits have been borrowing from the future — and the debt raised against those profits does not adjust.
segments.tr: Nếu các bộ tăng tốc AI bị lỗi thời về mặt chức năng nhanh hơn lịch trình giả định, lợi nhuận ghi nhận đã vay mượn từ tương lai — và khoản nợ huy động dựa trên lợi nhuận đó không tự điều chỉnh.

segments.src: Revenue attaches more slowly than capacity is added.** Capacity is being built ahead of demand by design; that is what an infrastructure race looks like.
segments.tr: **Doanh thu gắn liền chậm hơn tốc độ thêm năng lượng.** Năng lực được xây dựng trước nhu cầu theo thiết kế; đó là bản chất của một cuộc đua hạ tầng.

segments.src: But the gap between spend and monetization is currently being financed.
segments.tr: Nhưng khoảng cách giữa chi tiêu và thương mại hóa hiện đang được tài trợ bằng vốn vay.

segments.src: A prolonged gap turns a growth story into a refinancing problem.
segments.tr: Một khoảng trống kéo dài sẽ biến một câu chuyện tăng trưởng thành một vấn đề tái tái tài trợ.

segments.src: Rates or spreads move against them at the wrong moment.** These are strong credits with real cash flow.
segments.tr: **Lãi suất hoặc chênh lệch giá biến động bất lợi vào sai thời điểm.** Đây là những bên vay mạnh mẽ với dòng tiền thực tế.

segments.src: But the maturity walls being created now will be refinanced under conditions nobody can forecast, and the assumption that IG tech will always find a bid is untested at this volume.
segments.tr: Nhưng các bức tường đáo hạn đang được tạo ra lúc này sẽ phải tái tài trợ trong các điều kiện mà không ai có thể dự báo, và giả định rằng công nghệ IG sẽ luôn tìm được bên mua là chưa được kiểm chứng ở khối lượng này.

segments.src: ## The case for calm
segments.tr: ## Lý do để bình tĩnh

segments.src: The counterargument is not weak.
segments.tr: Lập luận ngược lại không hề yếu.

segments.src: Leverage ratios at most of these issuers remain low by any historical corporate standard — net debt to EBITDA figures that a utility or telecom operator would consider enviable.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ đòn bẩy ở hầu hết các bên phát hành này vẫn ở mức thấp theo bất kỳ tiêu chuẩn doanh nghiệp lịch sử nào — các con số nợ ròng trên EBITDA mà một nhà mạng viễn thông hoặc tiện ích sẽ coi là đáng mơ ước.

segments.src: Interest coverage is extraordinary.
segments.tr: Khả năng thanh toán lãi vay là cực kỳ tuyệt vời.

segments.src: The businesses funding the interest payments — cloud, advertising, enterprise software — are among the most durable cash engines ever built, and they are still growing.
segments.tr: Các doanh nghiệp tài trợ cho việc trả lãi — điện toán đám mây, quảng cáo, phần mềm doanh nghiệp — nằm trong số những cỗ máy tạo tiền bền vững nhất từng được xây dựng, và chúng vẫn đang tăng trưởng.

segments.src: There is also a real asset at the end of this.
segments.tr: Cũng có một tài sản thực sự ở cuối con đường này.

segments.src: Unlike the fiber build of the late 1990s, which produced capacity that sat dark for years, much of today's compute is being consumed on delivery.
segments.tr: Không giống như đợt xây dựng cáp quang cuối những năm 1990, tạo ra năng lực bị bỏ trống trong nhiều năm, phần lớn năng lực tính toán ngày nay đang được tiêu thụ ngay khi cung cấp.

segments.src: Utilization, where companies disclose it, has generally been high.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ sử dụng, ở những nơi công ty công bố, nhìn chung là cao.

segments.src: The reasonable position is neither "this is a bubble financed with debt" nor "these companies can afford anything."
segments.tr: Quan điểm hợp lý không phải là "đây là một bong bóng được tài trợ bằng nợ" cũng không phải là "các công ty này có thể chi trả cho bất cứ điều gì."

segments.src: It is that the risk profile of an entire sector has changed, and the market is in the middle of repricing it in real time.
segments.tr: Đó là hồ sơ rủi ro của toàn bộ một ngành đã thay đổi, và thị trường đang ở giữa quá trình định giá lại nó trong thời gian thực.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch
segments.tr: ## Những gì thực sự cần theo dõi

segments.src: For readers tracking this rather than trading it, a handful of indicators carry more signal than headline capex numbers:
segments.tr: Đối với những độc giả theo dõi vấn đề này thay vì giao dịch, một vài chỉ báo mang lại nhiều tín hiệu hơn con số capex tiêu đề:

segments.src: - **Free cash flow, not operating cash flow.** Operating cash flow tells you the business is healthy. Free cash flow tells you what is left after the build.
segments.tr: - **Dòng tiền tự do, không phải dòng tiền hoạt động.** Dòng tiền hoạt động cho bạn biết doanh nghiệp khỏe mạnh. Dòng tiền tự do cho bạn biết những gì còn lại sau khi xây dựng.

segments.src: - **Changes to depreciation schedules** disclosed in filings — an extension of useful life is a quiet earnings adjustment.
segments.tr: - **Thay đổi đối với lịch trình khấu hao** được công bố trong các báo cáo — việc kéo dài tuổi thọ hữu ích là một sự điều chỉnh lợi nhuận lặng lẽ.

segments.src: - **The ratio of committed to discretionary capex.** Discretionary spend can be cut in a downturn; contractual commitments cannot.
segments.tr: - **Tỷ lệ capex cam kết so với capex tự quyết.** Chi tiêu tự quyết có thể bị cắt giảm trong đợt suy thoái; các cam kết hợp đồng thì không.

segments.src: - **Spread behavior at issuance.** Whether new deals price with a concession relative to existing paper is the market's live verdict.
segments.tr: - **Hành vi chênh lệch giá khi phát hành.** Việc các đợt phát hành mới được định giá với mức chiết khấu so với giấy tờ hiện có hay không là phán quyết trực tiếp của thị trường.

segments.src: - **Disclosure of JV, SPV, and lease obligations**, which increasingly sit outside the headline debt figure.
segments.tr: - **Công bố về nghĩa vụ liên doanh, SPV và hợp đồng thuê**, những khoản này ngày càng nằm ngoài con số nợ tiêu đề.

segments.src: - **Any sign that shareholder return programs are being trimmed** — that would be management signaling the cash math has gotten tighter than guidance implies.
segments.tr: - **Bất kỳ dấu hiệu nào cho thấy các chương trình hoàn trả cho cổ đông bị cắt giảm** — đó sẽ là tín hiệu từ ban quản trị rằng bài toán tiền mặt đã trở nên hẹp hơn so với dự báo.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Lời kết

segments.src: The AI build-out is being financed the way large infrastructure has always been financed: with other people's money, on long timelines, against projected demand.
segments.tr: Đợt xây dựng AI đang được tài trợ theo cách mà các hạ tầng lớn luôn được tài trợ: bằng tiền của người khác, trên khoảng thời gian dài, dựa trên nhu cầu dự kiến.

segments.src: That is not scandalous.
segments.tr: Đó không phải là chuyện bê bối.

segments.src: It is simply a different business model than the one investors got used to, with a different set of failure modes.
segments.tr: Nó chỉ đơn giản là một mô hình kinh doanh khác với mô hình mà các nhà đầu tư đã quen thuộc, với một tập hợp các kịch bản thất bại khác.

segments.src: The companies that were famous for having no debt now have a maturity schedule.
segments.tr: Các công ty vốn nổi tiếng vì không có nợ giờ đây đã có một lịch trình đáo hạn.

segments.src: Whether that turns out to be prudent capital allocation or an expensive lesson depends on a question nobody can answer yet — whether the revenue arrives on the same timeline as the interest payments.
segments.tr: Việc điều đó trở thành sự phân bổ vốn khôn ngoan hay một bài học đắt giá phụ thuộc vào một câu hỏi mà chưa ai có thể trả lời — liệu doanh thu có đến cùng khung thời gian với các khoản thanh toán lãi vay hay không.
